description: This file defines a utility enum 'GenericPasswordKeychainStore' for securely storing, retrieving, and deleting string data in the Keychain on Apple platforms. It encapsulates the security logic for keychain interactions, providing methods to save, load, and delete generic password data associated with specific service and account identifiers.

methods.name: loadString
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from the keychain for given service and account identifiers.

methods.name: saveString
methods.description: Saves a string value to the keychain under specified service and account, with accessibility options.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the keychain item associated with the specified service and account.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Internal method to load raw data from the keychain for specified service and account.

methods.name: saveData
methods.description: Internal method to save raw data to the keychain, with rollback on failure.

methods.name: baseQuery
methods.description: Constructs the base query dictionary for keychain operations using service and account.
